topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.p: The Git Client add-on contributes a built-in Git client directly in . After you install the add-on, you can use the top-level Git menu, three dedicated views, a preferences page, and contextual Git actions in other views and editors.

Start with the interface overview to learn where Git actions are available. Then set up a repository and use the workflow sections to review, stage, commit, push, pull, and resolve conflicts. The add-on also uses the comparison and merge tools available in .
